changelog:
- New "API keyless" stats source, now the default: full stats with no key needed
- Added Watcher as a third blacklist (with its own key) and Luna as an optional ping source
- Fixed tags sometimes showing twice in chat or piling up in the tab list
- New Soundboard HUD: your sounds as buttons while the chat is open
- Choose who hears you right from the Voice HUD: everyone, only your party (new) or one of your groups
- Free sticker pack for everyone: 15 stickers (cats, emojis and memes)
- Stickers now work in /msg, /r, /pc and other chat commands
- Stickers now show in F2 screenshots on Badlion
- Stickers are 8 chat lines by default
- The overlay and tab stats now match the menu's theme by default, and you can pick the theme from the overlay page
- Changing an overlay setting now shows the real overlay for a moment instead of a preview inside the menu
- Floating cosmetics (clouds, disco ball) now float above the name and status
- Auras only show while you're on the ground, Zoomies are now cats, and cosmetics in first person are off by default
- The Discord button in the bottom left now says it opens Cosmetics
- Zeachify Studio has its own card in the menu, next to Recordings
- /req is now part of Auto requeue, Milk notifier moved to Game alerts, and Middle click buy is under "In a game"
- Big titles for alerts are on by default
- Fixed bugs and improved performance
- & more!
